contract.purpose: Fail release verification when any README included by npm packaging leaks unqualified Reasonix release identity.
contract.scope: Package readme discovery, forbidden command checks, allowed Reasonix-context classification, and package metadata assertions.

interfaces.interface-1: Packaged README file list from `npm pack --dry-run --json`
interfaces.interface-2: Reasonix context classifier shared by release-surface docs tests

invariants.invariant-1: Every packaged README is checked, including files npm auto-includes outside package.json `files`.
invariants.invariant-2: Old `npm install -g reasonix` and `npx reasonix code` primary install examples fail.
invariants.invariant-3: MAGRA README package set includes the current localized README files unless deliberately excluded by a future plan.
